title: Derceto
author: Mike MacDee
description: Hired to search the cursed Derceto mansion for the cause of Jeremy Hartwood's suicide. Start in the attic and work down; the front doors slam and trap you inside. Reproduction of the Alone in the Dark mansion in Doom Builder 2.

reviews.text: Closest I got is the IOS teeth area. No exit? ~1/5 for some good made areas with detail.

Map layout is quite rectangular and a bit cramped. Gameplay is not good: monster popups/teleports get boring. After grabbing the yellow key I took the nearest unopened door and got killed instantly. 2/5 because of the gameplay.
This is very buggy and unfinished but at least it's fun and looks great at times.
